subject: Nexus: term shift proposal, capacity uplift & executive alignment
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@nexuscorp.com>, engops@nexuscorp.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nexus: term shift proposal, capacity uplift & executive alignment

Hi Julia / Nexus team,

Following our renewal signals from last quarter, I wanted to start a short thread to align timelines and the stakeholders we should loop in. Quick context: Nexus is evaluating a term-shift (move to a 24-month committed term) and a ~1.6x capacity uplift tied to increased production traffic across your fraud-detection pipeline. We proposed a draft term adjustment and mutual action plan attached.

Key asks from our side to make the next two weeks smooth:
- Confirm the Nexus exec(s) who should attend the alignment call (product/eng exec + procurement)
- Confirm preferred QBR week for the renewal readout (we have Aug 3–7 open; propose Aug 5)
- Procurement contact for contract redlines and any required PO process

Attached: nexus_term_proposal_v2.pdf (term amendment draft) and mutual_action_plan.xlsx (proposed milestones + owners).

If you prefer, we can book a 30–45 minute exec alignment first, then the QBR which will include run-rate, capacity sizing, and the SLO/SLAs for the new term.

Thanks—next steps ideally by end of week so we can lock legal timelines.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference
(attachment: nexus_term_proposal_v2.pdf)
(attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx)

From: Julia Park <julia.park@nexuscorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: engops@nexuscorp.com, procure@nexuscorp.com
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nexus: term shift proposal, capacity uplift & executive alignment

Hi Sean—thanks for the note and for sending the docs.

High level: Nexus is supportive of a committed term if we can get predictable pricing and headroom for seasonal spikes. Team and contacts below:
- Julia Park (Eng Ops / primary) – julia.park@nexuscorp.com
- Marco Silva (Head of Product) – marco.silva@nexuscorp.com (would like to attend exec alignment)
- Helen Lee (Procurement) – procure@nexuscorp.com

Procurement asked that we run the QBR the week of Aug 3–7; their preference is Aug 5 (anytime between 09:00–13:00 PT). We can do an exec alignment call one business day earlier (Aug 4) to make sure the C-suite is aligned before the broader QBR.

I attached the Nexus procurement intake form for your legal team to review — it includes PO terms and our standard indemnity language. We’ll need a redline before Jul 27 to stay on the Aug timeline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Cheers,
Julia
Julia Park
Engineering Operations, Nexus Corp
(attachment: nexus_procurement_form.pdf)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Nexus: term shift proposal, capacity uplift & executive alignment

Kim / Monica — forwarding Julia’s reply and Nexus procurement form. Short internal plan:

1) Legal (Kim) — can you confirm whether we can accept Nexus’ PO cadence and the indemnity language subject to our standard SOC-2 carve? If legal can return a redline by EOD Jul 26 we should be able to meet the Aug 5 QBR date.

2) CS/Onboarding (Monica) — can you put together a one-pager run-rate/traffic forecast and what headroom we’d commit to for the first 90 days of the term? The customer expects a ~1.6x uplift on current spend; call out any staffing/Ops risks.

3) Sales ops — I’ll get calendar invites out for Aug 4 (exec alignment, 45m) and Aug 5 (QBR, 60m) pending Kim’s timeline. I’ll also attach the MAP and DEAL-6792 Jira for reference.

Quoted below for context:
> Hi Sean—thanks for the note and for sending the docs.
>
> High level: Nexus is supportive of a committed term if we can get predictable pricing and headroom for seasonal spikes...

Let me know if either of you sees any blocker. Monica, if you can draft the run-rate doc by EOD Jul 23 that would give us time to iterate with product.

Thanks,
Sean
(attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@nexuscorp.com>, engops@nexuscorp.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Confirming dates: Aug 4 exec alignment + Aug 5 QBR (Nexus)

Julia / team — thanks for the quick responses and for sharing procurement. Confirming the plan below and owners: 

- Aug 4, 2026 — Exec alignment call, 11:00–11:45 PT (Redwood execs: Sean + VP of Customer Success; Nexus: Marco Silva + Julia Park + Helen Lee) — purpose: agree term components, high-level capacity headroom, and who signs the amendment.
- Aug 5, 2026 — Renewal QBR, 10:00–11:00 PT — purpose: detailed capacity run-rate, SLO/SLAs, implementation milestones from the mutual action plan.

Action items and deadlines:
- Kimberly Park (legal) — redline Nexus procurement form by Jul 26 (Kim will send comments to Sean and Helen).
- Monica Patel (CS) — run-rate and initial staffing risk assessment by Jul 23.
- Sean Gallagher (AE) — send calendar invites and attach MAP + term draft.

I’ve attached calendar invites to this message (nexus_qbr_invite.ics, exec_alignment_invite.ics). Please confirm the times and that the attendees above are correct. If legal needs more time we’ll shift the QBR one business day but try to avoid delaying the renewal cadence.

Look forward to it.

Best regards,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
